visualCharacteristics: 2-up grid of large cards with full-bleed photo and dark overlay; eyebrow, heading, text (or logo image) and red pill CTA overlaid at left.
contentPattern: Repeating look-alike product cards (image, eyebrow, title, text, CTA) linking to detail pages; flows/wraps on mobile: Cards. | Same product-card pattern as rc10 (Credit Cards, Zelle): Cards.
usage: Two-up grid of large product cards with a full-bleed photo, dark overlay and eyebrow, heading, text and CTA overlaid.
reuseGuidance: Use for product/feature promo cards with text on top of a photo. For simple label-only linked tiles use cards-tiles.

blockStructure.source: get_block_details /block-collection/cards (container; child model 'card': image, imageAlt, text)

cells: Rich text: eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link

blockStructure.notes: rc6 tile images are CSS background-images on the anchor wrappers (not in cleaned.html); the importer must read the computed background-image. The whole tile is a link: put label as link in text cell.
